sources.title: Tencent Hy-MT2-30B-A3B model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the Hy-MT2 multilingual translation family, its nominal 30B-A3B MoE size, text translation examples, public weights, and May 21, 2026 open-source release.

sources.title: Hy-MT2 official repository README
sources.evidence: News explicitly says Hy-MT2-30B-A3B was open-sourced on Hugging Face and ModelScope on 2026.5.21; deployment section states max_context: 8192.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-30B-A3B license
sources.evidence: Names this exact checkpoint and explicitly licenses it under Apache License 2.0.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-30B-A3B checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: HYV3ForCausalLM; 48 layers, first layer dense, hidden size 2048, 128 routed experts with top-8 routing plus one shared expert, expert width 768, GQA with 32 query/4 KV heads, head dimension 128, untied embeddings, 120832-token vocabulary and max_position_embeddings 262144; no quantization configuration.

sources.title: Complete indexed checkpoint and all 51 safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Fetched only bounded header byte ranges for every shard at this revision. All 18673 tensor names and shapes match the configured graph. 30064725888 stored elements comprise 30064719872 BF16 parameter elements and 6016 F32 router-bias buffer elements. Header byte totals equal the index total_size; no full weights downloaded.

sources.title: Tencent checkpoint conversion implementation
sources.evidence: Maps checkpoint mlp.expert_bias to mlp.e_score_correction_bias, router.gate to gate, and shared_mlp to shared_experts; expert tensor fusion preserves element counts.

sources.title: HYV3 model implementation
sources.evidence: Complete configured module graph has attention, MLPs, routers, embeddings, output head and RMSNorm parameters. e_score_correction_bias is a non-parameter Buffer; RoPE inverse frequencies are nonpersistent buffers. MoE routes eight experts and adds the shared expert. The checkpoint has no extra/MTP tensors.

sources.title: HYV3 configuration defaults and layer construction
sources.evidence: Defaults attention_bias and mlp_bias to false, defines one dense layer followed by sparse layers, and defines the parameterization used to independently reconstruct all indexed checkpoint shapes.

sources.title: Exact released checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Accepts tool signatures, instructs model-selected function calls with named arguments, serializes assistant tool_calls and tool results. Also exposes high/low/no_think reasoning_effort and thinking-token generation; defaults to no_think. Template capability alone does not establish trained reasoning quality.

sources.title: Hy-MT2 technical report, revision 2 (May 25, 2026)
sources.evidence: Latest revision listed by arXiv during this audit. Describes fast-thinking multilingual translation, explicitly introduces this MoE variant and evaluates its translation/instruction following. Supplies no separately defined exact total/active-count table or evidence of a trained reasoning mode.

developer.note: Tencent Hunyuan Team develops the model; Tencent owns the checkpoint license.

family.note: Normalize the explicitly named Hy-MT2 family to the catalog family key.

release_date.note: Explicit dated open-source availability announcement for this exact model; not inferred from repository upload or later provider listing.

open_weights.note: Public complete checkpoint shard index and accessible headers, with model-specific redistribution license.

license.note: Exact checkpoint LICENSE.txt names Apache License 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Complete parameter count: 30,064,719,872. Independently reconstructed every configured tensor shape and reconciled all 18,673 indexed tensors across all 51 headers. Excludes 47 router-bias buffers (6,016 elements); includes 18,626 BF16 parameter tensors, all experts, attention/norm/router weights and separate embedding/output matrices. tie_word_embeddings=false; no quantization scales or packed tensors, no extra/MTP parameters. Publisher designation 30B is nominal.

active_parameters_b.note: Retain the publisher's nominal A3B designation, not an exact checkpoint-derived activation count. Config confirms eight of 128 routed experts plus one shared expert in each of 47 sparse layers. Publisher does not define the embedding/output-matrix counting convention; do not equate the nominal 3B with an exact per-token arithmetic sum.

architecture.note: Autoregressive Transformer with one dense and 47 MoE layers, 128 routed experts/top-8 plus one shared expert, GQA, RoPE and Q/K RMSNorm.

context_window.note: Retain the explicitly documented deployment max_context=8192. The checkpoint configuration ceiling is 262144 positions; this higher architectural limit does not establish documented translation quality or recommended serving length. Preserve the distinction.

modalities.note: Text translation model and tokenizer/causal language-model architecture; template extracts text content and has no image/audio encoder path.

reasoning.note: Published translation model is presented/evaluated in fast-thinking mode, but the exact template also permits high/low reasoning_effort and emits an opening think token. Neither false nor trained reasoning support is established unambiguously; clear the baseline false.

tool_call.note: Exact shipped template supports tool signatures, model-selected named function calls with arguments, assistant tool_calls and tool-response messages. This establishes a supported tool-calling prompt protocol, not benchmarked tool-use reliability.

description.value: Tencent Hy-MT2 multilingual text translation model with a mixture-of-experts architecture and support for terminology, style, context and structured-translation instructions.
description.note: Replace unsupported coding, agent and reasoning-model description with the documented translation purpose.

HYV3 configuration defaults and layer construction

patch.notes: Total parameters (30.064719872B) are a complete checkpoint count after excluding 6,016 non-parameter router-bias buffer elements; all 51 shard headers and the configured module graph were reconciled. Active 3B is Tencent's nominal A3B designation, with no exact activation-count convention disclosed. Documented deployment context is 8,192 tokens; config permits 262,144 positions. Exact template supports tool-call protocol and optional reasoning modes, but trained reasoning capability is unresolved.

summary: Verified explicit May 21 release, Apache-2.0 weights and MoE structure. Replaced generic coding/agent prose and normalized family. Complete metadata/implementation audit gives 30.064719872B total parameters; nominal 3B active is qualified. Retained documented 8K context with 262K configuration caveat, confirmed template-level tool-call support, and cleared unsupported reasoning=false. Latest report revision and exact-model searches were checked; no later primary report with an exact active-count convention was found.
